scope: Frozen posterior numerical-refinement check by same-dimension likelihood importance reweighting, not refined-target MCMC or independent mock calibration
stopping: Evaluate all six cases on all 8192 cold states, no thinning/hot/replay pooling, changed priors/data/cutoffs, extra cases, retuned gates or extension until pass. If overlap or stability fails, report failure; do not certify a refined posterior.
uncertainty: Paired ratio-estimator influence batch means at lengths 64 and 128 within each independent chain; use larger MCSE. Importance overlap index is not autocorrelation-corrected MCMC ESS.
limits: One synthetic target; baseline monitored mixing gates must pass
Only five scalar and six fixed field projections tested for marginal stability
Product mesh and particle lattice refine together
Same 64-dimensional white prior and physical scalar priors; likelihood-only ratios
Quantile shifts are point estimates with no quantile MCSE gate
